esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; U2.TXD → RX2 (the board's RX), RXD → TX2 (the board's TX). Added a separate 5 V supply for +5V (it needs 4.9–5.1 V and up to 500 mA, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the zphs01b.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the CO2, PM2.5, temperature, humidity and gas readings set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; U2.TXD → GP1 (the board's RX), RXD → GP0 (the board's TX). Added a separate 5 V supply for +5V (it needs 4.9–5.1 V and up to 500 mA, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the zphs01b.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the CO2, PM2.5, temperature, humidity and gas readings set on the sliders: passes
